_: pt-BR for the dashboard. The page is written in English; when the machine's language is pt-BR it rewrites what it shows with this file: 'exact' replaces a whole piece of text, 'rx' rewrites a phrase inside one (JavaScript regular expressions, applied in order). Text with no entry stays in English. Card titles, logs and what the agents wrote are never touched.
